path_to_distress.reading: The company is far from distress, and nothing in the filings points toward it. Distress would need several conditions to arrive together. First, the cash cushion of {terms.cash_and_short_term_investments_now} would have to be used up; there is no debt, current debt is {terms.debt_now.parts.debt_current}, and the cash runway is not computed because free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple} is positive, so the runway field would only come into play once free cash flow turned negative. Second, the off-balance-sheet purchase commitments would have to turn into cash outflows that sales do not recover: the notes give "of which $9.4 billion have expected receipt dates within 12 months", and those goods must be taken and paid for whether or not AI demand holds. If demand faltered, inventory of {terms.balances_now.inventory}, already at {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory} days of cost, would swell and write-downs would follow, and the record tags no inventory reserve to show the cushion. The company's own history shows the mechanism: in fiscal 2022, when inventory days climbed from {trend_table.years-back-4.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} to {trend_table.years-back-3.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, operating cash flow was only {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} times net income. Third, the deferred-revenue inflow that now supports operating cash flow would have to stop or reverse, for example if trial and acceptance terms were not met and products came back; current contract liabilities are {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities}. Fourth, the quarter's gross margin of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct} would have to keep falling under memory and silicon costs and large-customer discounts until operating cash flow no longer covered the commitments. Interest coverage is not a trigger here: it is not in the calculator, and there is no debt to cover. Even together, these conditions would first drain the net cash before they could threaten solvency.

summary_ko.dupont: 자기자본이익률 {ratios.profitability.dupont.product|pct}는 주로 순이익률 {ratios.profitability.dupont.net_margin|pct}에서 나오며, 총자산회전율 {ratios.profitability.dupont.asset_turnover}과 자기자본승수 {ratios.profitability.dupont.equity_multiplier}는 낮습니다. 즉 부채나 자산 회전이 아니라 높은 마진이 수익성을 이끌고, 최근에는 세율 상승으로 순이익률이 다소 낮아졌습니다.
summary_ko.path_to_distress: 차입금이 없고 현금 및 단기투자자산이 {terms.cash_and_short_term_investments_now}에 달해 부실과는 거리가 멉니다. 부실로 가려면 AI 수요가 꺾인 가운데 대규모 구매약정 대금을 치르며 재고가 쌓이고, 이연매출 유입이 멈춰 잉여현금흐름({free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple})이 마이너스로 돌아서는 일이 한꺼번에 일어나야 합니다.
